findings.title: Every task verifies only `bash tests/run.sh`; no commands cover Bash 3.2 confirmation, focused tests, shipped-script syntax, ShellCheck, documentation, release negatives, or qualification rehearsal
T002 runs the deterministic driver “before” an LLM but does not require LLM invocation only after a named judgment boundary
T002 lacks structured decision inputs and explicit plan-drafting, blocker, and conflicting-review boundaries, leaving room for forbidden prose heuristics
T001 defines no actionable acknowledgement verb for existing repositories and does not explicitly test that read-only and planning commands remain ungated
T001 does not require explicit disclosure when vendor sandboxing or OS-level containment is unavailable
T003 omits explicit full preflight, repo-local configuration validation, and the guarantee never to overwrite user files
T004 omits explicit failures for placeholder versions, dirty archives, moving release references, installer-behavior mismatches, and undocumented ShellCheck exceptions
T005 does not explicitly require anonymized concise evidence, and its end-to-end rehearsal omits the beta-qualification step
